correctness.rationale: PASS. Every symmetric, nonnegative, row-stochastic P supported on C_n² with loops has SLEM ||P−J||₂, convex and invariant under dihedral conjugation; averaging yields a circulant orbit-uniform optimizer without increasing norm, so the attained optimum is unrestricted. Fourier modes have q(t)=1−4at−16bt(1−t), t=sin²(πk/n). The sampled quadratic g(t)=t(ℓ+r−t) has minima ℓr at endpoints and maximum at j=floor((n+2)/4), verified by the four congruence classes of n. Balancing the two positive endpoints and negative interior contact gives a=(ℓ+r−1)/(2d), b=1/(8d), d=ℓr+u(ℓ+r−u), and rho=[u(ℓ+r−u)−ℓr]/d. Explicit modulo-4 positivity of h=1−2a−2b and a,b establishes feasibility. For n≥6 the difference between any competing orbit-uniform q and optimum divided by t is affine, so three alternating contacts force uniqueness of orbit-uniform optimum; n=5 handled separately. Global uniqueness for nonuniform walks is NOT claimed. Expansion gives 1−rho=8π²/n²+O(n^{−4}) compared to one-hop 2π²/n². Independently assembled all Fourier constraints and solved fresh linear programs for every 5≤n≤74; every optimum and eigenmode bound agrees within numeric tolerance; finite LP does not prove all n.

originality.rationale: PASS, best of knowledge for closed-form all-size discrete-time two-hop-cycle SLEM optimum, its exact weights, three contact frequencies and factor-four leading gap versus best one-hop. The primary Boyd–Diaconis–Xiao 2004 framework gives general SDP and Boyd–Diaconis–Parrilo–Xiao 2009 gives graph symmetry reduction and a different ONE-HOP cycle explicit calculation. Neither inspected theorem specifies this distance-two minimax solution for all n. Published Saha–Das 2025 adjacency spectra of C_n² are unweighted and do not optimize transition probabilities. Similar degree-two sampled trigonometric extremals use a distinct coefficient/positivity normalization; no sound equivalence deriving this SLEM solution was located.
residual_risks: An alternative degree-two trigonometric minimax theorem may derive the result in disguised variables; inspected closest records have distinct constraints and no proven domination.
Closed-form optimizer is unique only among orbit-uniform circulant walks; unrestricted nonuniform optimizers are not classified.
Factor-four speedup is in asymptotic spectral-gap leading constant, not necessarily full total-variation mixing-time ratio.
